items.quote: - [x] **WIRE-01**: Each of the six query candidates (naive, bypass, hybrid, local, global, hipporag) can be resolved by at least one production
- [x] **WIRE-02**: parse_wiring reports a named violation whenever a top-level provides entry or evidence_position.node names a node missing
- [x] **WIRE-03**: ResponseEnvelope.stop_reason and degradation_reason, and the same two fields in the non-debug /trace/resolve output, never contain
- [x] **WIRE-04**: When no provides node produced a completion (a failed or partial run), ResponseEnvelope.depth_label is null instead of 'stage'.
- [x] **WIRE-05**: Every refusal the runner raises before dispatch, and every cyclic-wiring outcome, reaches REST as a structured SeamRefusalError
- [x] **WIRE-06**: parse_wiring returns a ValidationReport and never raises for a malformed document. It covers doc=[], nodes=None and nodes=[1].
- [x] **WIRE-07**: Execution placement has one source. validator/depth.py no longer defines derive_execution_mode;
- [x] **WIRE-08**: A guard fires only on the value it declares. evaluate_guards compares a declared output field (or signal) of the evaluating node,
- [x] **WIRE-09**: The LightRAG local and global arms' keyword fall-through guards (ll_keywords_empty_fallthrough, hl_keywords_empty_fallthrough)
- [x] **WIRE-10**: Every node in the wiring has exactly one NodeTrace in the run record, including nodes the TaskGroup cancelled because a sibling failed
- [x] **WIRE-11**: NodeTrace fields report what was measured. An execution_mode field is stamped on every node (in-process, subprocess and so on)
- [x] **WIRE-12**: RunRecord identity and persistence describe the run accurately. concurrency_setting reflects that ready batches run concurrently
- [x] **WIRE-13**: SeamEvent records are correct. A mutating node whose execution raised gets outcome 'failed', not 'halted';
- [x] **WIRE-14**: Engine internal paths fail by name and open the correct stores. An evidence_position node returning a dict without 'items' raises
- [x] **WIRE-15**: environment_hash's docstring lists every input. Whether platform.platform() (kernel release and glibc) is included follows the owner decision,
- [x] **WIRE-16**: The four advanced query members (embedding, predicates, profile_ref, formal_query) are permanently refused for this contract version,
- [x] **WIRE-17**: Each refusal type that shipped wirings can only partly reach has a test that pins where it can occur.
- [x] **WIRE-18**: The runner exposes no unused scheduling or budget API. The determinism_setting and concurrency_setting parameters of run_wiring
